SELECT (P2 - P1) * 100.0 / P1 FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) as P1, SUM(CASE WHEN period='P2' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) as P2 FROM events WHERE event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn'))
